description: Expose a public method on the FileSystem interface that allows reading file content when PocketBase is used in embedded mode. This will provide direct file access without requiring HTTP requests or test package workarounds. The caller will be responsible for properly closing the returned reader.
functional_requirements: Add a public method to the FileSystem interface that returns a readable stream for a given file identifier
Ensure the method works correctly when PocketBase is running in embedded mode (not just HTTP server mode)
Implement proper error handling for cases where the file doesn't exist or cannot be accessed
Document that the caller must close the returned reader to prevent resource leaks
Include appropriate unit tests that verify the reader functionality works in embedded scenarios
Maintain backward compatibility with existing file system operations
